title: working on new map and boss mechanics for my TD game, what do you think?
author: shoukachidev
selftext:
Currently working on new boss mechanics, this one is for the raven knight which has a shout that intimidates all the owls for a couple of seconds, stopping them from attacking.

  
First, i let GPT create a concept art for the map. Then, i took it to Claude and Blender and let it build the map itself. Afterwards, we decided on some shaders and effects (like the rain and fog). Music is done by myself in FL Studio.

Finally, i needed a boss. My idea was that every level has its own boss with its own quirks and abilities. So i thought "Yeah a big guy with a big axe needs to shout". 

  
Game runs flawless on 180fps on highest settings, really glad how it turned out so far.

  
Please let me know what you guys think :)
